resources.string: Xiaomi may stop the app completely – then no alarms arrive. Turn on “Autostart” and set Battery saver to “No restrictions”.
Samsung may put the app to deep sleep – then no alarms arrive. Under Battery › Background usage limits, add it to “Never sleeping apps”.
Huawei/Honor may stop the app – then no alarms arrive. Under Battery › App launch, choose “Manage manually” and allow all options.
OnePlus may stop the app – then no alarms arrive. Allow “Auto-launch” and, under Battery usage, background activity.
Oppo/Realme may stop the app – then no alarms arrive. Allow “Auto launch” and, under Battery usage, background activity.
Vivo may stop the app – then no alarms arrive. Allow “Autostart” and, under Battery, high background power use.
